gear.name: Trail Rations
gear.description: Hardtack and salted mud-meat. Restores stamina and a touch of HP when eaten.

gear.name: Wild Onion
gear.description: Pulled from the silt by its papery tops. Sharp, watery, fills a corner of the gut.

gear.name: Wild Carrot
gear.description: Pale, slender, and earth-streaked. Snaps clean between the teeth. Helps you see in the half-dark for a while after.

gear.name: Wild Lettuce
gear.description: Bitter green leaves growing low. Easier to find than swallow.

gear.name: Rhubarb Stalk
gear.description: Sour red stalk pulled from the ditch's edge. Wakes you up either way.

gear.name: Wild Oats
gear.description: A handful of grass-seed grain. Chew and swallow; that's the entire recipe.

gear.name: Speckled Egg
gear.description: A speckled egg from a ground-nester. Cracks open warm enough to swallow raw. Sticks to your bones.

gear.name: Blueberries
gear.description: A palmful of dusky blueberries. The blue gets on everything. Old Tartarian herbalists called them clarity-fruit.

gear.name: Raspberries
gear.description: Soft, tart, falls apart on the tongue. A handful gets you to the next ridge.

gear.name: Wild Grapes
gear.description: Tight clusters of small grapes pulled off a low vine. Half-sweet, half-puckering. Loosens the tongue.

gear.name: Wild Chicken
gear.description: A scrawny ground-bird, freshly killed. Real food, the kind that pays you back.

gear.name: Red Cap Mushroom
gear.description: Bright red cap, white-speckled. Edible raw if you must; better in a stew.

gear.name: Blue Cap Mushroom
gear.description: Bruise-blue cap, deep purple gills. Tastes of cold stone.

gear.name: Violet Cap Mushroom
gear.description: Deep violet cap, almost black. Eaten raw it does very little; cooked or distilled, more. Quickens the feet either way.

gear.name: Orange Sporecap
gear.description: Bright orange cap, freckled with darker spots. Don't eat raw unless you know the color. You know the color.

gear.name: Aetheric Torch
gear.description: Reliable light. Faintly attracts Aether-drawn creatures.

gear.name: Aetheric Locket
gear.description: Hums when held close to a relic.

gear.name: First Aid Kit
gear.description: Sterile bandages, mud-glass needles, a single dose of Aetheric salve. Restores 1d6 HP on use.

gear.name: Aetheric Compass
gear.description: A compass that points at the strongest local Aether source. Rarely north.

gear.name: Climbing Rope
gear.description: Fifty feet of mud-treated rope. Holds a Giant's weight if you don't push it.
